quotes.text: Disturbingly, the rapid rise of Artificial Intelligence is coinciding with an explosion of child exploitation reports using generative AI. There is a clear social cost to AI, and there must be AI industry accountability for its negative fallout. https://t.co/QLgRJ3guBB

The CEOs of the largest AI companies are expressing urgent alarm and calling for Congress to slow down the pace of AI development. 

I joined dozens of colleagues in a letter to Speaker Johnson to cancel this Thursday’s recess to enact safeguards to protect mankind. https://t.co/4lDSmyzh5X
Despite the urgent need to pass AI safeguards, Speaker Johnson just shut down the House of Representatives for the next seven weeks. It’s outrageous. https://t.co/LxjpEwZT5G

Speaker Johnson cancelled 2 scheduled weeks in September, shutting down the House of Representatives until November 11th. That’s unacceptable given the urgent warning from AI executives that Congress needs to act. There are bipartisan bills that will put long-overdue guardrails on AI, to protect program “breakouts,” and minors from AI deepfakes that we could vote on right now. Johnson’s recess is irresponsible.

It's beyond irresponsible that Speaker Johnson is choosing to shut down the House of Representatives while AI executives are sending urgent warnings on the need for AI safeguards. Congress would not be starting from scratch on this issue. There are commonsense, bipartisan AI safeguard bills ready to be voted on. For example, I strongly support the AI Kill Switch Act to put emergency third-party protections in place to protect against the threat of rogue AI programs acting outside of human control.

I am also a cosponsor of the Preventing Deepfakes of Intimate Images Act, a bill to criminalize creating and posting non-consensual deepfakes on social media. This bill is especially needed to address the disturbing surge of instances of generative AI use related to child sexual exploitation reported to the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children. The House could vote on these two bills today and take real action to protect the public.

With the growing number of incidents involving rogue AI agents, Congress must pass commonsense safeguards to protect the public. 

Last week, I officially became a cosponsor of the bipartisan AI Kill Switch Act, a bill to establish third-party protections against rogue AI agents. We need safeguards that ensure AI remains under human control.
